title: Interview feedback + HC sync — prep notes (Sasha)
body:
Purpose:
Quick personal prep notes for Thursday HC sync + interview-feedback flow discussion. Aim: align on immediate headcount moves for Q2, tighten the interview loop for IC4+ roles, and agree on debrief action cadence so offers move faster.

Meeting goals (2 main outcomes):
- Decision: final prioritization of top 6 reqs across Eng/Product/DS for Q2 (who to push vs pause).
- Process: approve 1 small change to interview loop and one automation to close feedback gaps (see proposals).

Snapshot (rough):
- HC budget remaining: ~12 FTEs (committed 8, flexible 4). finance slack msg from Jan 28 said floor 10 - confirm.
- Critical reqs: infra-ml (2), serving-runtime (1 senior eng), product-ml (1), SRE (1), growth-eng (1).
- Pipeline health: top-of-funnel OK, onsite-to-offer conversion lagging (5 candidates in final stage >14 days).

Priority roles + quick notes:
1) infra-ml Sr (IC5) — interviewers overloaded; need to swap in Marco (kernel infra) for system design panel. Candidate A has strong latency work but no infra open-source; lean yes if compensation alignment.
2) serving-runtime Eng (IC4) — loop currently: phone -> take-home -> onsite(4). Proposal: replace take-home with 90m paired coding to speed turnaround.
3) product-ml PM — hiring manager requests faster loop; consider reducing interviewers from 5 -> 4 and use scorecard prioritization for hire/no-hire.

Proposed interview-loop changes (one-slide ask):
- Replace take-home for senior ICs with timed paired session (25% faster feedback, fewer no-shows). Pilot for 4 roles.
- Standardize debrief template: 6 bullets (impact, craft, systems, collaboration, signals, fit). Must be submitted within 24h or auto-reminder to manager.
- Add an auto-summary step in Greenhouse (or our ATS) that compiles scores and highlights >1 SD divergence for immediate reviewer. (Linked: JIRA-2145).

Debrief template (draft to propose):
- One-sentence summary of hire/no-hire decision
- Top 2 strengths
- Top 2 risks/unknowns + suggested mitigation if hired
- Role fit (1-5) & comp expectation sanity check
- Decision driver (technical, org, compensation, timeline)
- Follow-up owner + due date

Action items to propose in meeting (owner / timeline):
- Confirm top 6 priorities (Sasha / by Fri 2025-02-07)
- Pilot paired session for serving-runtime and infra-ml (Diego / launch week of 2025-02-17)
- Update debrief doc and add 24h reminder flow in ATS (Priya / PR to ATS config by 2025-02-14)
- Marco to cover interview panel for infra-ml this week and provide panel notes template (Marco / 2025-02-06)

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: paired sessions might bias in-person coders over take-home; mitigation: structure prompts to favor architecture and tradeoffs, not micro-syntax.
- Risk: managers skip 24h debrief during crunch; mitigation: escalate to recruiting lead with weekly report listing delayed debriefs.

Open questions to bring up: 
- Are we comfortable pausing 2 mid-priority reqs to free budget for infra-ml hires? (Finance constraints?)
- Can Recruiting Ops support the ATS automation this sprint or do we need a dev ticket?

Notes to self (for the sync):
- Start with headcount snapshot (1 min), then elevator pitch for loop change (2 min), then discuss top roles (10 min), finish with action items & owners (2 min). Keep timeboxed.
- If pushback on paired sessions, offer 1-month pilot and commit to conversion metrics (time-to-offer, candidate NPS).
- Pull in recent candidate >14 day cases as example (GH ref: candidate IDs in linked slack thread).

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send within 24h):
- TL;DR decisions (who we greenlit/paused)
- List of agreed process changes + owners/timelines
- Attach updated debrief template + link to pilot plan
- Ask: managers to clear feedback for pending 5 candidates in 48h or we auto-archive to re-activate later

Scratch ideas (random):
- Quick hire pathway for critical infra roles: 3-interviewer shortlist + 48h exec review window for offers.
- Consider small signing bonus for infra hires given competing offers — ask comp to model.

Misc refs and links to drop in the meeting doc: 
- Link to finances note Jan28 (finance slack)
- JIRA-2145 (ATS debrief automation)
- Slack thread: #recruiting-final-stage-stalls (G1234/p2345)

End of notes.
